x-note: datamancy.dev is a cryptographically verifiable static MCP serving the datamancy grimoire as raw markdown. The manifest is ECDSA P-256 signed; the npm adapter (`npx -y datamancy`) verifies the signature against a public key pinned in the package source, then verifies the SHA-256 of each fetched spell against the signed manifest. No content reaches the LLM unverified. The practitioner's identity card is at https://datamancer.dev; the chronicle is at https://algebraic-intelligence.dev.
